questions.q_en: A and B can complete a work in 4.5 hours and 5.4 hours, respectively. After finishing that work together, they receive an amount of Rs.3080. What is the share of A in that amount?
questions.solution_en:
Ratio of times taken by A and B = 4.5: 5.4 = 5: 6

Ratio of efficiencies of A and B = 6: 5

Total amount = 3080

Share of A in that amount = 3080 * 6/11 = 280 * 6 = Rs.1680

questions.q_en: Raghav is 30% more efficient than Bhunesh and Chandan is 20% less efficient than Bhunesh. If they work together, they can finish a work in 52 days. In how many days will Raghav alone complete 25% of that work?
questions.solution_en:
Raghav  Bhunesh   Chandan

 Efficiency                13           10          8

Total work = (13 + 10 + 8) × 52 = 31×52 units

To complete the 25% of the work, days required by Raghav is =  (31×52)/(13×4)

   = 31 Days

questions.q_en: 3 men and 4 women can construct a road in 60 days while 10 men and 12 boys can construct 75% of the road in 18 days. It will take how much time to 4 men, 2 women and 3 boys to construct the complete road?
questions.solution_en:
Let one man, one woman and one boy can construct the road in m days, w days and b days respectively.

3/m + 4/w = 1/60..(i)

10/m + 12/b = 1/((100/75) * 18))

10/m + 12/b = 1/24..(ii)

By taking 2(i) + (ii), we get

6/m + 8/w + 10/m + 12/b = 2/60 + 1/24

16/m + 8/w + 12/b = 1/30 + 1/24

4/m + 2/w + 3/b = 3/160

So, 4 men, 2 women and 3 boys can together construct the complete road in 160/3 days.

16/m + 8/w + 12/b = 1/30 + 1/24

4/m + 2/w + 3/b = 3/160

So, 4 men, 2 women and 3 boys can together construct the complete road in 160/3 days.

questions.q_en: Sam completed a work in 36 days and Veer is 80% more efficient than Sam. They start working together, but Veer left the work after 9 days due to some issue, then Sam alone can complete the remaining work in:
questions.solution_en:
Sam alone completed the work in 36 days.

Thus, Veer alone completed the work in = 36 * 100/180 = 20 days

In 9 days, part of work done by Sam and Veer = 9 * (1/36 + 1/20) = 7/10

So, remaining work = 1 - 7/10 = 3/10

Hence, Sam alone can complete the remaining work in = 3/10 * 36 = 10.8 days

Required days = (40a/8a) = 5 days

questions.q_en: 15 men or 20 women can do a piece of work in 24 days. Find the time taken by 10 men and 8 women working together to do the double of that work.
questions.solution_en:
Let the time taken by 10 men and 8 women together is 'T'.

15M = 20W

3M = 4W

The total worker = 10 men + 8 women = 10 men + 8 women = 16 men

15M * 24/1 = 16M * T/2

T = 15 M * 24 * 2/16 = 45 days

questions.q_en: A man, a woman, and a boy can complete a job in 10, 15, and 20 days respectively. When working together, how many boys must assist one man and one woman to complete the work in 3/5th of a day?
questions.solution_en:
Total work = LCM of 10, 15, and 20 = 60 units

Efficiency of A man = 6 units per day

Efficiency of a woman =4 units per day

Efficiency of a boy = 3 units per day

Let the required number of boys = X

Therefore,

(6 + 4 + 3X) * (3/5) = 60

10 + 3X = 100

3X = 90

X = 30

questions.q_en: Anil alone can complete a work for Rs.24000 in 30 days but with the help of Suresh, the work is completed in 20 days. The share to be paid to Suresh is:
questions.solution_en:
Let total work = LCM of 30 and 20 = 60 units

Efficiency of Anil = 60/30 = 2

Efficiency of Anil and Suresh together = 60/20 = 3

Efficiency of Suresh = 3 - 2 = 1

Share of Suresh = 24000 * 1/3 = Rs.8000

questions.q_en: If A and B can complete a piece of work in 15 days and 25 days respectively. Find the time taken by A and B together to complete the same piece of work.
questions.solution_en:
Total work = LCM of 15 and 25 = 75 unit

Efficiency of A = 75/15 = 5 unit

Efficiency of B = 75/25 = 3 unit

Time taken by A and B to complete the work when working together = 75/(5 + 3)

=> 75/8 = 9 (3/8) days

questions.q_en:
A and B together can complete a work in 6 hours and 40 minutes, while B alone can complete the work in 12 hours. If they completed work together for Rs.11016, then which of the following statements is/are true?

(P) The share of B is Rs.210 more than Rs.6000.

(Q) The share of B is Rs.120 more than Rs.6000.
questions.solution_en:
The time taken by A and B together to complete the work = 6 hours and 40 minutes = 6(2/3) hours

The time taken by B alone to complete the work = 12 hours

Now,

(1/A) = (3/20) - (1/12) = 1/15

So, the time taken by A alone to complete the work = 15 hours

The ratio of the efficiencies of A and B = 12: 15 = 4: 5

So, the share of B = 11016 X 5/9 = Rs.6120

Hence, only statement Q is true as 6000 + 120 = Rs.6120

=> 36/5 = (x + 18)/10

=> x = 54

questions.q_en: A, B, and C together can do a piece of work in 24 days and B alone can do the same piece of work in 96 days. If the efficiency of C is 80% more than the efficiency of B, then find the time taken by A to do the work.
questions.solution_en:
Total work = L.C.M of 24 and 96 = 96

Efficiency = Total Work/ Time Taken

Efficiency of A, B, and C = 96/24 = 4

Efficiency of B = 96/96 = 1

Efficiency of C = Efficiency of B * 180/100 = 1 * 180/100 = 1.8

Efficiency of A = 4 - (1 + 1.8) = 1.2

Hence, the time taken by A to do the work = 96/1.2 = 80 days

questions.q_en: A and B together can complete a work in 5 days, B and C together can complete it in 10 days and C and A together can complete it in 20 days. Find the time taken by B alone to complete the work.
questions.solution_en:
Total work = LCM of 5, 10 and 20 = 20 units

Efficiency of (A + B) = 20/5 = 4 units

Efficiency of (B + C) = 20/10 = 2 units

Efficiency of (C + A) = 20/20 = 1 unit

Efficiency of 2(A + B + C) = 7 units

Efficiency of (A + B + C) = 3.5 units

Subtracting efficiency of A and C together from efficiency of A, B and C together, we get -

3.5 - 1 = 2.5 unit

Required time = 20/2.5 = 8 days

questions.q_en: 20 persons started a work together, but after some days, 8 persons leave. As a result, the job, which could have been completed in 80 days, was completed in 100 days. How many days after commencement of the work did the four persons leave?
questions.solution_en:
Let the number of days be X after which the four persons leave the work after commencement.

Total work = 20 * 80 units

Total work = [20X + 12(100 - X)] units

Now,

1600 = 20X + 1200 - 12X

400 = 8X

X = 50

questions.q_en: Ashu can do a piece of work in 40 days. He completed 5/8 of the work and then left it. Shweta can complete the remaining work in 18 days. If they work together they will complete 110% of the same work in-
questions.solution_en:
Part of work done by shweta in 18 days= 3/8

So, whole work can be completed by shweta in 18 x 8/3 = 48 days

Let total work = LCM of 40 and 48 = 240 units

Efficiency of Ashu = 240/40 = 6 units per day

Efficiency of Shweta = 240/48 = 5 units per day

Together they will complete 110% of 240 in [240* (110/100)]/11 = 24 days

questions.q_en: A contractor takes a contract to construct the road in 32 days and employed some no. of workers. 8 workers were absent from beginning, the rest workers completed the work in 36 days. Find the initial no. of workers?
questions.solution_en:
Let initial workers be 'w'

Total work completed in 32 days = w x 32

If 8 workers were absent from the beginning then left work is done by (w - 8) workers in 36 days

Using formula, M1D1 = M2D2

=> 32 x w = 36 x (w - 8)

=> W = 72

=> Initial no. of workers = 72
